$comment: Held-out evaluation labels (scripts/eval.py). knownPositives come from a code audit by an AI agent (Claude) that read only the project's source at the pinned revision: it did not run Midwrite and did not see its output. findings are classified afterwards, finding by finding, with the Phase 2 classes. No independent human review has been performed; an AI agent checking another AI agent's results is not independent human validation. Corrections go in `corrections` with a reason, never by editing a label to raise a score.

knownPositives.scope: unhandled half-written-state windows in server code; the audit was capped at 30 entries, highest confidence first, so the list is a sample when the project has more

findings.by: AI agent (Claude), finding-by-finding source review, separate from the auditor; did not see knownPositives

knownPositives.consequence: Card committed in its own transaction; a failure afterwards leaves a card without the requested labels/members or their activity rows, the client sees an error and a retry creates a duplicate card.

knownPositives.secondEffect: cardRepo.reorder at line 1524 (then label/member relationships, checklists, activities)
knownPositives.consequence: Partial duplicate left behind (wrong index, or no labels/members/checklists) and a retry creates a second copy; the comment at 1491-1494 admits the card cannot be rolled back.

knownPositives.firstEffect: cardRepo.reorder at line 1121 (preceded by an independent cardRepo.update at 1107)
knownPositives.consequence: A card moved to another board keeps members without access to that board and misses its move/title/due activities; the title update can commit while the reorder fails.

knownPositives.secondEffect: permissionRepo.createRole at line 104 (loop) then db.insert(workspaceMembers) at line 117
knownPositives.consequence: No transaction: a workspace can exist with missing system roles or without its admin member row, so the creator cannot manage it.
Paid workspace created without a subscription row; the Stripe retry finds the workspace (check at line 72) and skips creation, so the subscription is never recorded.
The Stripe seat count is raised and billed but the member is never created (or is soft-deleted by the compensation path, which never decrements the seat).
The Stripe seat is incremented and billed without a member; each retry of the invite link increments it again.

knownPositives.secondEffect: updateSubscriptionSeats(-1) at line 295 (error only logged at 308)
knownPositives.consequence: The member is removed but the Stripe seat is never decremented and nothing reconciles it.
The S3 object exists with no row referencing it (never cleaned up), or the attachment row has no activity entry.
The S3 object is deleted while the attachment row stays live: a broken attachment pointing at a missing file.
The list is deleted while its cards stay live and reachable, without archive activities.
The board is deleted while its lists and cards stay live, reachable and counted, without archive activities.
The board exists without the requested lists/labels, the client gets an error, and a retry creates a second board with a suffixed slug.
All items are soft-deleted while the checklist stays visible and empty, with no activity recorded.
A Trello board failing midway stays half-imported but counted as failed; a crash leaves the import row stuck in its initial status.
A GitHub project can be half-imported and the import record never reaches success or failed.
The license slot is linked but the workspace stays on the free plan; a retry sees the workspace already linked and never repairs the plan.
Comments render through activity rows, so a comment without its activity is stored but invisible; a retry posts a duplicate.
The label is stripped from every card (hard delete, unrecoverable) but survives as a live label.

knownPositives.secondEffect: workspaceRepo.update (plan) at line 388 (Promise.all, no transaction; after workspaceRepo.create at 345)
knownPositives.consequence: The partner slot is consumed while the workspace plan stays free, or the reverse.
Partner subscriptions are unlinked but the workspace survives, still marked paid, with no backing subscription.

knownPositives.secondEffect: subscriptionRepo.updateById at line 79 / workspaceRepo.update at line 82
knownPositives.consequence: New slots are created but not linked, or linked without the plan update; a webhook retry sees the slot count already raised and does not re-link.

knownPositives.firstEffect: cancelWorkspaceAccess at line 248 / slot and workspace updates at 287/299
knownPositives.consequence: Workspaces can be paused/downgraded while their license slots still read active, or the reverse.
An invited member row exists but no invite email was sent, and a retry is rejected because the email is already a member.
The avatar object is uploaded but the user still points at the old image: an orphaned S3 object.
A dangling incomplete subscription row is left without a checkout session; each retry adds another.
The existing invite link is revoked but no replacement is created: the workspace has no working invite link.
The card is archived without its archive activity: incomplete audit trail.
A system role exists with no permissions, so members assigned to it are denied everything.
A Pro subscription is marked active with unlimited seats while previously paused members stay paused.

findings.notes: partner/link.ts:68-74 links the slot then updates the plan in separate writes; a revisit redirects at :50, so the workspace stays on the old plan with the slot linked.
partner/webhook.ts:61 and :97 insert license slots in separate statements with linking at :74-87 between; a failure leaves fewer slots than the tier.
Deactivate path: webhook.ts:239-251 downgrades workspaces (utils/workspace.ts:31-40) before :253 cancels subscriptions, no transaction: free workspaces with active subscriptions.
create_checkout_session.ts:105-111 inserts an 'incomplete' placeholder before the Stripe session (:128); a failure looks like an abandoned checkout, which the design tolerates.
stripe/webhook.ts:75-93 creates the workspace then the subscription without a transaction; the redelivery guard at :72 skips both, so the subscription row is never created.
upload/attachment.ts:134 is only an activity row after the attachment insert (:120); attachments load from the relation (card.repo.ts:624).
upload/avatar.ts:108-121 uploads before storing the key; a failure leaves an unreferenced object at a deterministic key that a retry overwrites.
attachment.ts:163 audit row after the insert at :146; attachments are read from the relation.
attachment.ts:217 deletes the S3 object before the soft-delete at :226; a failure leaves a visible attachment pointing at a missing file.
attachment.ts:231 only an audit row after the soft-delete at :226.
board.ts:431 commits the board (board.repo.ts:639) before lists at :455 in another transaction; a failure leaves a board without lists and a retry duplicates it.
board.ts:455 lists and :467 labels are independent commits: a new board missing its requested labels.
board.ts:528-535 handles the favorite toggle separately on purpose and idempotently (onConflictDoNothing); an independent preference.
board.ts:626 soft-deletes the board before its lists (:633) without a transaction; lists and cards stay live under a deleted board and a retry cannot fix it.
board.ts:633 lists and :646 cards are soft-deleted in separate commits: live cards in deleted lists.
board.ts:666 only audit rows after the cards' soft-delete at :646.
card.ts:146 commits the card (card.repo.ts:50) before labels at :170 in another transaction; the client gets an error and a retry duplicates the card.
card.ts:188 only activity rows after the label links at :170; labels are read from the relation.
Card create: a failure after :188 and before the member links at :198 leaves the card without its assignees, no transaction or compensation.
card.ts:216 only activity rows after the member links at :198.
card.ts:220 `void sendMentionEmails(...)` is fire-and-forget.
card.ts:229-254 webhooks are marked non-blocking with a log-only .catch.
Mention email (card.ts:220, void) and webhook (:230, .catch) are both best-effort.
Comments render only through their activity (ActivityList.tsx:406, card.repo.ts:738-818); if card.ts:320 fails after the insert at :308 the comment is invisible.
card.ts:328 `void sendMentionEmails(...)` is fire-and-forget.
card.ts:413 audit row after the edit at :402; the UI reads the comment row.
card.ts:422 `void sendMentionEmails(...)` is fire-and-forget.
card.ts:506 audit row after the soft-delete at :494; deleted comments are filtered (card.repo.ts:817).
card.ts:585 audit row after the label link delete at :577.
card.ts:705 audit row after the member link delete at :694.
card.ts:737 audit row after the member link insert at :729.
card.ts:1156 `void sendMentionEmails(...)` after the update at :1107 is fire-and-forget.
Mention email (card.ts:1156, void) then an audit row (:1230): accepted and harmless.
card.ts:1107/:1121 commit update and move before :1215-1226 unassigns members not on the new board; no transaction.
card.ts:1230 only audit rows after the member removals at :1216.
card.ts:1267-1296 webhooks are non-blocking with a log-only .catch.
Mention email (card.ts:1156, void) and webhook (:1268, .catch) are both best-effort.
card.ts:1361 audit row after the transactional soft-delete at :1355.
card.ts:1367-1393 webhooks are non-blocking with a log-only .catch.
Duplicate commits the new card (card.ts:1513) before labels (:1538) in another transaction: a partial duplicate without labels.
card.ts:1545 only audit rows after the label links at :1538.
Duplicate: a failure after :1545 and before the member links (:1567) leaves the copy without its members.
card.ts:1577 only audit rows after the member links at :1567.
checklist.ts:80 audit row after the checklist create at :68.
checklist.ts:149 audit row after the rename at :138.
checklist.ts:201 soft-deletes all items before the checklist (:207) without a transaction: a visible empty checklist.
checklist.ts:207-219 the checklist soft-delete commits before the activity insert; only the audit row can be lost.
checklist.ts:277-289 item created in its own tx, then an activity row; only the audit row can be lost.
checklist.ts:364-372 updateItemById (non-tx, checklist.repo.ts:162) commits before reorderItem's separate tx; a reorder error leaves the request failed with the change persisted.
checklist.ts:372-387 reorder commits, then a completion activity row; losing it is harmless.
checklist.ts:387-399 both writes are audit activity rows.
checklist.ts:452-464 item soft-delete then only the item.deleted activity row can be lost.
health.ts:54-55 both client.send calls are read-only HeadBucketCommand probes in a health check.
import.ts:50 getTrelloTokenForUser only lazily re-encrypts the stored token, an idempotent migration unrelated to the imports row at :260.
import.ts:319-349 the board commits before labels with no transaction or cleanup: a visible half-imported board.
import.ts:349-361 labels commit, then lists per iteration with no outer transaction: board missing lists and cards.
import.ts:361-382 each list's tx commits before its cards' tx, no cleanup: empty or missing lists.
import.ts:382-406 a failure after the cards commit aborts the rest of the import with no cleanup.
import.ts:406-455 cards and activities commit before checklists in a separate tx: cards without checklists.
import.ts:455-496 checklists and their items commit in separate transactions: empty checklists.
import.ts:496-526 checklist items commit before the card-label links: cards missing labels.
import.ts:260/:561 the imports row is created 'started' (import.repo.ts:23) and finalized later by design; a crash leaves the in-progress marker.
import.ts:737-828 a failure after the 'started' tracking row leaves only that harmless status row.
import.ts:828-864 the GitHub-import board commits before its labels with no transaction or cleanup.
import.ts:864-909 labels commit before lists: a board with labels but no lists or cards.
import.ts:909-964 the lists tx commits before the cards tx: empty lists.
import.ts:964-995 a failure after the cards commit aborts activities and label links with no cleanup.
import.ts:974-995 cards and activities commit before the card-label links: cards without their labels.
import.ts:995-1005 the board is fully imported; only the status row stays 'started', a harmless marker.
label.ts:232-234 card-label links are hard-deleted (card.repo.ts:1127) before the label soft-delete commits separately: a live label removed from every card.
list.ts:126-138 the list soft-delete commits before the cards soft-delete (card.repo.ts:1067); live cards under a deleted list, and a retry cannot repair it.
list.ts:138-156 only the card.archived activity rows can be lost.
member.ts:109 Stripe seats increase before the seat-limit check (:150) and memberRepo.create (:173), with no decrement on failure.
member.ts:173-189 the invited member commits before signInMagicLink; compensation (:202) runs only on a falsy status, not on a throw or crash, and the row blocks re-invites (:71).
member.ts:189-206 softDelete runs only when signInMagicLink reports failure; there is no path where the email was sent and the DB change is then missing.
member.ts:266-317 the Stripe seat decrement after the soft-delete is in a log-only try/catch: deliberately best-effort.
member.ts:475-486 active invite links are deactivated (inviteLink.repo.ts:48) before the new link is inserted: no working invite link.
member.ts:704 Stripe seats increase before the seat-limit check and the member insert, with no compensation.
workspace.ts:345-385 the workspace commits before partner-slot linking; a failure leaves the workspace without its plan and the slot unlinked.
workspace.ts:384-390 subscription link and workspace plan update run in Promise.all without a transaction.
notifications.ts:118-148 the mention email and the notification row each sit in a log-only try/catch: explicit best-effort.
utils/workspace.ts:31-40 member pause and plan downgrade run in Promise.all without a transaction; called from partner/webhook.ts:248.
hooks.ts:62-92 avatar upload and user.image update share a log-only try/catch; a failure orphans an object at a deterministic key, best-effort mirroring.
hooks.ts:88-121 subscriber.create is in its own log-only try/catch: best-effort marketing sync.
hooks.ts:106-138 subscribers.create and workflows.trigger are each log-only try/catch: best-effort.
plugins.ts:56-65 member pause and workspace downgrade run in Promise.all without a transaction in onSubscriptionDeleted (:146).
plugins.ts:123-141 unlimitedSeats is set before members are unpaused in a separate write: a Pro workspace with paused members.
boardMember.repo.ts:181-195 removeAllForMember's only caller (member.repo.ts:173) passes the transaction handle, so both writes are atomic.
permission.repo.ts:388-405 role and permissions are inserted separately and the only caller (workspace.repo.ts:104) passes plain db: a role with no permissions.
workspace.repo.ts:76-104 the workspace commits before its system roles, with no transaction from either caller.
workspace.repo.ts:104-117 roles commit before the creator's admin member row: an orphaned workspace.
